verdict.rationale:
Cal.com ships robust official API v2 docs (auth, bookings, events, webhooks), a Platform SDK with React 'atoms' and managed users for building on top of Cal.com, an official CLI for agentic use, and a hosted/local MCP server explicitly documented for AI agents to book, check availability, and manage event types. This directly satisfies an AI-native user wanting to build against official SDKs/APIs.
